desc: Read the integer N and the sequence A from standard input.
Sort the sequence A in non-decreasing order.
Iterate from $i = 0$ to $\lfloor N/2 \rfloor - 1$, adding $(A[N - 1 - i] - A[i])$ to `total_score`.
Print the final `total_score` to standard output.
Write the final Python code block enclosed in the required delimiters.
